plugin.name: Databases
plugin.description: Postgres, MySQL, SQLite and Redis nodes, with new-row poll triggers for Postgres and SQLite.
plugin.author: Landflow

nodes.name: postgres
nodes.description: Query, insert, update, upsert and delete rows in PostgreSQL
nodes.subtitle: {{operation}}

options.name: Delete
options.description: Delete rows matching conditions

options.name: Execute Query
options.description: Run an SQL query with bound parameters

options.name: Insert
options.description: Insert rows in a table

options.name: Insert or Update
options.description: Insert rows, or update them when the key already exists
options.action: Insert or update rows in a table

options.name: Select
options.description: Select rows from a table

options.name: Update
options.description: Update rows in a table

properties.name: query
properties.description: The SQL to run. Put values in $1, $2, … placeholders and list them in Options → Query Parameters instead of writing them into the SQL.
properties.placeholder: SELECT id, name FROM orders WHERE status = $1 AND total > $2

properties.name: table
properties.description: The table to work on (loaded live with the credential)

properties.name: deleteAll
properties.description: Allow deleting without conditions. Off by default: a delete without conditions is refused.

properties.name: where
properties.description: Conditions rows must meet. Values are always sent as bound parameters.

values.name: column
values.description: A column of the table; checked against the table's columns when the node runs

options.name: AND
options.description: Only rows that meet all the conditions

options.name: OR
options.description: Rows that meet at least one condition

properties.name: returnAll
properties.description: Whether to return all results or only up to a given limit

properties.name: limit
properties.description: Max number of rows to return

values.name: column
values.description: A column of the table; checked against the table's columns when the node runs

options.name: Map Automatically
options.description: Use the item fields whose names match columns of the table; other fields are ignored

options.name: Map Each Column Manually
options.description: Set the value of each column below

values.name: column
values.description: A column of the table; checked against the table's columns when the node runs

properties.name: columnsToMatchOn
properties.description: Comma-separated column(s) of a unique key. A row with the same values is updated instead of inserted.

properties.name: columnToMatchOn
properties.description: The column that identifies the rows to update (usually the primary key)

properties.name: valueToMatchOn
properties.displayName: Value of Column to Match On
properties.description: Rows whose match column equals this value are updated

values.name: queryReplacement
values.description: Values for the $1, $2, … placeholders: a comma-separated list, or an expression returning an array such as {{ [$json.status, $json.total] }}

values.name: queryBatching
values.description: How to run the query for several input items

options.name: Single Query
options.description: Run the query once, with the first item's parameters

options.name: Independently
options.description: Run the query once per item

options.name: Transaction
options.description: Run the query once per item, all in one transaction; any failure rolls back every item

values.name: outputColumns
values.description: Comma-separated columns to return (all columns when empty)

values.name: returnRows
values.description: Output the rows as stored (RETURNING *), with generated ids and defaults. Off: insert outputs the values written, update outputs {success, affectedRows}.

nodes.toolDescription: Read or change data in a PostgreSQL database. Set `operation`: `select` reads rows of `table` (up to `limit`), `executeQuery` runs the SQL in `query` (use $1, $2, … placeholders for values), `insert` / `upsert` / `update` write the other arguments as columns of `table` (fields that are not columns are ignored), and `deleteTable` deletes rows matching the node's configured conditions.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The value to write. Hash: a JSON object; List and Sets: a JSON array (or one value).

properties.name: valueIsJSON
properties.description: Whether the hash value is a JSON object; otherwise “field value field value …”

properties.description: Whether to return the value of each key, or only the key names

properties.name: limit

properties.name: list
properties.description: Name of the list

properties.name: propertyName
properties.description: Field of the output item that receives the length

properties.name: tail
properties.description: Whether to push or pop at the end (right) of the list instead of the start (left)

properties.name: channel
properties.description: Channel to publish the message to

properties.name: messageData
properties.description: Data to push or publish

values.name: dotNotation
values.description: Whether a property name like a.b sets the nested field b of a, instead of a field called “a.b”

nodes.toolDescription: Read and write a Redis server. Set `operation`: `get` (value of `key`), `set` (`key` to `value`, optional `expire` with `ttl` seconds), `incr`, `delete`, `keys` (keys matching `keyPattern`, with values), `push`/`pop` on the list `list` (`messageData` to push), `llen`, `publish` (`messageData` on `channel`) or `info`.

keyPattern.description: Glob pattern for keys, e.g. user:*

nodes.name: postgresTrigger
nodes.description: Starts the workflow when new rows appear in a PostgreSQL table (polling)
nodes.subtitle: New rows in {{table}}

properties.name: pollingNotice
properties.displayName: This trigger polls the table for new rows. Unlike a LISTEN/NOTIFY trigger it needs no trigger functions in the database and works with any user that can read the table.

options.name: New Row
options.description: A row whose tracking column is greater than any seen before

properties.name: pollInterval
properties.description: Seconds between checks for new events while the workflow is active (minimum 10)

properties.name: trackingColumn
properties.description: A column that only grows, such as an auto-increment id or a created_at timestamp. Rows are emitted in its order; use a unique column so no two rows share a value.

properties.name: limit
properties.description: Rows emitted per poll at most; the rest follow on the next polls
